accepted.matchup: Delaware Blue Hens @ Western Kentucky Hilltoppers
accepted.reason: WKU's offense is near the bottom of FBS (132nd in points per drive, 16 ppg vs FBS, last 4 FBS games under), Delaware is 0-3 on the road, and both sides have skill-position injuries; projections cluster around 48-55. Sharp money reportedly hit the under elsewhere while DraftKings still shows 57.5.

Columbus (2.33) and Philadelphia (1.85) are two of the league's lowest-scoring teams, and 15 of their 22 combined games stayed under 5.5; a shot-based estimate of about 5.4 goals makes the under about 54%, yet the market makes the over a slight favorite.
